about_the_game:
This is a fairy tale for adults.

Demo Content

The demo includes the first chapter of the game, which tells the story of the protagonist's real life before entering the fantasy world. Before being overwhelmed by anxiety, these subtle emotions were already present in everyday life.

Full Game Intro

Anxiety Puppy is an interactive visual novel that tells the story of a young girl in a bustling city, who, while struggling with the pressures of life and work, unexpectedly embarks on a spiritual journey toward reconciling with her anxiety.

Her life trajectory seems no different from anyone else’s—studying, finding a job, working, with days that repeat endlessly.

However, only she knows that beneath every seemingly calm day, anxiety grows like an uncontrollable black line, suffocating her breath and tightening her nerves.

On one of her usual sleepless nights, her anxiety spirals out of control again, and she is pulled into a strange world. What is it? She doesn’t know, but maybe she can talk to it.

Game Features:

  • Fresh Hand-drawn Style – A beautiful, healing, original illustrated storybook art style.

  • Unique Game Theme – The game focuses on anxiety and aims to raise players’ awareness of this emotion.

  • Warm and Healing Story – The protagonist will undergo self-exploration through dialogue and interaction, ultimately finding reconciliation with herself.

Her story is not a lonely one.

She could be you, or me, or anyone struggling with anxiety.

But in reality, anxiety is not our enemy.

It is more like a well-meaning but awkward friend, and we just haven’t learned how to get along with it yet.

This time, let anxiety transform into a little puppy, guiding you on a healing journey of self-reconciliation.

We hope that the next time you feel anxious, you will no longer criticize your emotions or yourself.

Because anxiety is not a monster; it’s just a little puppy easily unsettled.

If you're looking forward to meeting the little puppy, add it to your Wishlist!

  • Processor: 2.8GHz CPU Quad Core
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 860 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

Recommended:

  • Processor: 3.2GHz CPU Quad Core
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

short_description: Anxiety Puppy is a 2D interactive narrative game that focuses on anxiety. In the game, anxiety is personified as a little puppy. Players will explore its story and try to coexist with it. Go find its traces and give it a hug.
